plotEn:
Seok-hwan is a job seeker who repeatedly fails job interviews despite receiving support from his best friend, Young-ha, and his younger sister, Ye-rin. After returning home from another disastrous interview, he is attacked by a group of strangers and dies.
72 hours after his death, Seok-hwan unexpectedly awakens and discovers that he possesses the ability to resurrect after dying. Soon afterward, a mysterious individual known as Black becomes aware of Seok-hwan's existence and begins pursuing him. As Seok-hwan repeatedly dies and resurrects, he gradually develops greater physical abilities and becomes increasingly powerful.
